_about: Which VAT rate level each EU country applies to a kind of goods (a catalog tax category). A level is one of standard, reduced, reduced_alt, super_reduced, zero; its rate per country comes from the world-tax crate's table. A country may instead point at an entry of _overrides: a rate that table lacks, given in basis points (500 = 5 %) and valid for that one country. A country missing from a category is taxed at its standard rate. Drawn from the European Commission's 'VAT rates applied in the Member States' (2025): food is basic foodstuffs, medicines are sold without prescription, press is newspapers and periodicals. Have an accountant review it before relying on it: rates and their scope change. The effective rates are tabled in docs/invoicing.md (a test keeps the table current).

_review.reviewed_by: Claude Code, against the Commission's 'VAT rates applied in the Member States' (January 2025) and the national changes of 2025 and 2026 (EE, CZ, LV, LT, SK, RO, FI); not a professional opinion
